+(91) 9949004553
Kotachakravarthi9@gmail.com

I am dedicated payroll specialist with 2+ years of experience in accurately processing payroll for weekly and 
Biweekly, proficient in ADP Workforce Now and JodDiva, Processing of off cycle payments (ACH), Terminations, ADP 
Notes, timesheet collection, Bonus calculations, creating miscellaneous invoices, expenses invoices retro payment

Finance Executive Exceed Management Pvt. Ltd - Hyderabad

Approvals for making Payments and responsible for Getting receivable amounts from Clients.
